title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper Story of Two GPUs: Characterizing the Resilience of Hopper H100 and Ampere A100 GPUs
problem: Reproducibility of GPU resilience characterization studies requires independent artifact evaluation.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative aims to validate published results through independent evaluation.
method: Artifact evaluation of SC25 paper 'Story of Two GPUs' by Cui et al., assessing experimental setup and result reproducibility.
key_novelty: Reproducibility report (meta-paper) documenting artifact evaluation of GPU resilience study.
contributions: Artifact evaluation of GPU resilience characterization
Documentation of SC25 Reproducibility Initiative work
limitations: Reproducibility report only; limited details without access to full original paper content
